# رواد الليزر — Ruwwad Laser

> Ruwwad Laser (رواد الليزر) is a Saudi metal laser company in Jeddah. It handles laser cutting, bending and forming, stainless steel fabrication, and laser engraving / fiber marking. Its focus is batch and volume orders for companies, contractors, factories and projects. Typical orders are 25–50+ plates, tags or parts, plus repeat production runs.

- Website: https://rowadlaser.com (Arabic and English)
- WhatsApp / phone: +966 55 021 4342 (0550214342)
- Email: info@rowadlaser.com
- Location: Jeddah, Saudi Arabia (also serves Makkah)
- Hours: Saturday to Thursday, 8 am to 6 pm

## Who we serve best
- Contractors, especially MEP, electrical and fit-out. They need project identification packages: valve tags, cable tags, LOTO tags, safety signs and route markers, numbered from the project schedule.
- Factories and workshops that need laser-cut parts, data plates and serial-number marking in batches.
- Restaurants, hotels, hospitals and companies that need stainless steel fittings, office signage, or staff name badges in quantity.
- Design offices and developers that need metal façades, decorative metal and signage for commercial buildings.

## Why customers choose us
- Batch orders made easy: serial numbering straight from Excel, with delivery sorted to the project list.
- Production starts within 6 hours of approving the quote and proof.
- Accuracy of ±0.1 mm, on 10+ metals: steel, stainless, aluminium, copper, brass and galvanized.
- Every number and letter is checked against the customer's list before delivery.
- One accountable partner for the whole order, from drawing to delivery.

## Arabic summary
رواد الليزر شركة سعودية في جدة، متخصصة في قص المعادن بالليزر وتشكيلها، وتصنيع الستانلس ستيل، والحفر بالليزر (فايبر ماركينق). نركّز على **طلبات الكميات والدفعات** للشركات والمقاولين والمصانع والمشاريع، مثل دفعات من 25–50 لوحة أو تاق أو قطعة فأكثر، والطلبات المتكررة. يبدأ التنفيذ خلال 6 ساعات من اعتماد عرض السعر، بدقة ±0.1 مم، ونفحص كل رقم وحرف قبل التسليم. للتواصل: واتساب 0550214342.

## Main services
- [Laser metal cutting](https://rowadlaser.com/laser-metal-cutting.html): CNC laser cutting of sheet metal in batches.

- [Stainless steel fabrication](https://rowadlaser.com/stainless-steel-fabrication.html): commercial kitchens and fittings.
- [Laser engraving in Jeddah](https://rowadlaser.com/laser-engraving-jeddah.html): data plates, serial numbers, QR codes and logos.
- [Identification labels and tags](https://rowadlaser.com/industrial-labels-tags.html): project packages for contractors and facilities.
- [MEP identification package](https://rowadlaser.com/mep-identification-package.html): valve tags, cable tags, panel labels, LOTO tags and safety signs for a whole project, from one supplier.

## How to order
Send the drawing or list (Excel or PDF), the material, the quantity and the deadline by WhatsApp (+966 55 021 4342) or through the quote form at https://rowadlaser.com/contact.html. The customer receives a clear quote and a digital proof before production starts.
